title: Pending-effect record (ADR 0006 §5.4)
description: One staged send-class call awaiting the press: a brokered request of kind "effect" backed by a durable row keyed by effect_id. One effect = one request = one execution. Field rules are §5.4; conditional requirements below encode the lifecycle invariants (a closed row names its close reason; decided-or-later rows carry the recorded decision; only ran-to-outcome rows carry outcome).

request.description: The brokered-request handle. A retried open with a caller-named handle dedupes to the same request (existing:true); it never double-stages.

agent.description: The calling alias, connection-derived (CAD-376) — never requester-supplied input.

account.description: The enrolled account handle under the platform (§5.1, §7 Q4).

tool.description: The adapter tool name, as declared in the reviewed tool table.

effect.description: Only sends pend; reads and drafts execute at call time and never produce this record.

input_summary.description: One bounded line for list surfaces; secret-guarded like every durable agent text. The bound here is the fixture's cap, not the contract's number.

input.description: The exact staged call arguments the press approves — the bytes the proxy fires on accept. No credential field exists. Any JSON value; the proxy applies a byte bound.

preview.description: The rendered, bounded artifact the press reviews — what the platform will do, in the platform's terms. Secret-guarded. The bound is the fixture's cap.

source_hash.description: Optional. Content hash of the reviewed source artifact the send derives from. Editing the source while the row is waiting cancels it (close_reason source_changed); Execute re-verifies the hash before firing (§5.4 step 3).

label.description: Optional. The platform's own effect class where it differs from cadence's (the AgenticOS mapping, §5.2). Display only.

effect_id.description: The durable identity; one effect = one request = one execution. The write's idempotency key derives from it (C9).

state.description: waiting → decided → executing → done|failed. declined: decided decline, never ran. closed: cancelled before release (see close_reason). reconcile: restart found decided(accept) without a proven outcome — awaits a human; never re-fires automatically.

close_reason.description: Required on closed rows — why the pending effect was cancelled (e.g. source_changed, credential_revoked).

decision.description: The recorded press. accept is operator-only in v1; decline is open to anyone authorised (§5.4 step 4). An agent never releases.

by.description: The verified presser and the rule that authorised them. {member, role, rule} leaves room for policy/team release (§6) without a format change.

at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the recorded decision.

reason.description: Optional; a decline parks the reason.

outcome.description: The platform result or platform error, delivered as a message and parked as the request answer. verified is the adapter's read-back against the approved input (C10).

result.description: The platform outcome payload; mutually exclusive with error.

error.description: The platform error; mutually exclusive with result.

verified.description: Read-back verdict against the approved input. false raises a Needs-you item; unknown is a legitimate steady state where no read-back exists.
